info.title: Selling Partner API for Listings Items
info.description:
The Selling Partner API for Listings Items (Listings Items API) provides programmatic access to selling partner listings on Amazon. Use this API in collaboration with the Selling Partner API for Product Type Definitions, which you can use to retrieve the information about Amazon product types needed to use the Listings Items API.

For more information, refer to the [Listings Items API Use Case Guide](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/listings-items-api-v2021-08-01-use-case-guide).

Issue.description: An issue with a listings item.

actions.description: List of enforcement actions taken by Amazon that affect the publishing or status of a listing.

IssueEnforcements.description: Provides information about the enforcement actions taken by Amazon that affect the publishing or status of a listing. It also includes details about any associated exemptions.

action.description:
The enforcement action name.

Possible values:

* `LISTING_SUPPRESSED` - This enforcement takes down the current listing item's buyability.

* `ATTRIBUTE_SUPPRESSED` - An attribute's value on the listing item is invalid, which causes it to be rejected by Amazon.

* `CATALOG_ITEM_REMOVED` - This catalog item is inactive on Amazon, and all offers against it in the applicable Amazon store are non-buyable.

* `SEARCH_SUPPRESSED` - This value indicates that the catalog item is hidden from search results.

IssueEnforcementAction.description: An enforcement action that Amazon takes that affects the publishing or status of a listing.

status.description: Indicates the current exemption status for the listed enforcement actions. It can take values such as `EXEMPT`, signifying permanent exemption, `EXEMPT_UNTIL_EXPIRY_DATE` indicating temporary exemption until a specified date, or `NOT_EXEMPT` signifying no exemptions, and enforcement actions were already applied.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: This status is assigned to a product listing when it has been exempted from the listed enforcement actions. In cases of `EXEMPT`, Amazon acknowledges the existence of enforcement actions but ensures the user that these actions are not applied to the listing. The user is advised to consider addressing the issue, although enforcement actions are not taken.

This status indicates that a product listing has been granted a temporary exemption from the listed enforcement actions. The exemption remains in effect until a specified expiry date. After this date, Amazon enforces the listed actions. The `expiryDate` field provides the timestamp indicating when the temporary exemption ends, adhering to the ISO 8601 format.

This status is assigned to a product listing when it has no exemptions from the listed enforcement actions. When the status is `NOT_EXEMPT`, it signifies that Amazon has already taken the specified enforcement actions. There is no exemption in place, and the listed actions are actively enforced.

expiryDate.description: The timestamp, in ISO 8601 format, when the temporary exemption expires and Amazon begins enforcing the listed actions.

IssueExemption.description: The status of the listed enforcement actions. If applicable, includes information about the exemption expiry date.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: The offer on this listings item is available for Business to Consumer purchase, meaning that it is available to shoppers on Amazon retail sites.

ItemOfferByMarketplace.description: Offer details for a listings item for the specified Amazon store.

discountPercentage.description: The seller-funded Subscribe & Save discount on the offer, as a percentage (0–100). For example, `5` means 5% off; `0` means the selling partner funds no discount.

ReplenishmentDiscount.description: A replenishment discount set by the selling partner on the offer for Subscribe & Save subscriptions.

discountType.description: The quantity price type, indicating whether the quantity discount is a fixed price set in the local currency for each quantity threshold, or a percentage discount on the price.

x-docgen-enum-table-extension.description: The quantity price is a percentage discount offered on the price for each quantity threshold. For example, a value of `5.0` means 5% off.
The quantity price is a fixed price set in the local currency for each quantity threshold.

levels.description: The quantity discount levels that define the discount at each quantity threshold.

QuantityDiscountPlan.description: The active quantity discount plan for an offer. A quantity discount plan defines discounts on the offer price based on the purchase quantity. There are two types of discounts: fixed prices based on the order quantity, and percentage discounts on the price based on the order quantity.

lowerBound.description: The quantity threshold, which is the minimum purchase quantity necessary to receive the discount. The discount applies to all units when the quantity threshold is met.

QuantityDiscountLevel.description: A quantity discount level, defining the discount applied when the purchase quantity meets a given threshold.

ItemProcurement.description: The listings item's vendor procurement information.

ItemRelationshipsByMarketplace.description: Relationship details for the listing item in the specified Amazon store.
